study type: Cohort study (secondary analysis of a randomised infant feeding trial)
exposure: being overweight at 2-10 years of age
Residence region (Australia, Canada, Northern Europe, Southern Europe, Central Europe and the USA)
cohort: 2,149 children with an affected first-degree relative and increased HLA-conferred risk of type 1 diabetes
finding: Being overweight at 2-10 years of age was associated with increased risk of progression from multiple islet autoimmunity to type 1 diabetes and with development of type 1 diabetes, but not with development of islet autoimmunity.
country: Multiple (Australia, Canada, Northern Europe, Southern Europe, Central Europe and the USA)
